# Lane 2.238: the guard at start reads the fence itself

## Builder 1 (embedded database), 2026-11-26

- **What exists.** `checkLoginRole` (`packages/database/src/db/check-login-role.ts`), the one function the website (`apps/web/src/server/startup.ts`), the worker (`apps/worker/src/start-worker.ts`), `probe-logins` and `npm run test:real-postgres` run, now ends with `checkFence` (`check-fence.ts`). Its signature is unchanged, so no caller changed (two comments only). It refuses, each with one mending statement: (a) a league table (a `league_id` column, or the table one points at) in any schema, not enabled and forced: `alter table … force row level security`; (b) a policy on one not in `migration-catalog.ts` word for word: `drop policy …`, or a changed one: `alter policy … to … using (…) with check (…)`; (c) a security-definer function (not a trigger) the login or a role it may become can run, any schema, not in `reviewed-definers.ts`: `revoke execute on function … from <every holder it reaches>`; (d) a table, view, materialized view or foreign table in the migrations' schemas not in the catalog: `drop table …`.
- **How it knows the migrations (T-468).** `migration-catalog.ts` is generated by `npm run db:types` from a fresh run with the guard's own queries (`fence-catalog.ts`); `migration-catalog-file.test.ts` fails when it is stale. **Reviewed list (T-469):** 9 functions with reasons (the step's 8 plus `keep_email`, which app_user may also run); `isolation-coverage.test.ts` holds it to what app_user may run. T-470, T-471 are the other choices. Pending files only; T4's T-60 line corrected.
- **Tests.** `check-fence.test.ts` (13): nothing planted passes; each plant is refused with its exact sentence, then the sentence's own statement is run and the guard passes again; the new-migration case is a planted table in a catalog that lists it, named by (a) alone. Each test was broken by hand once and failed. In `check-login-role.test.ts` the 2.202 plant `platform.made_up_kept` now also trips (d): that sentence is set aside in its role tests and asserted once.
- **Time.** The whole guard on PGlite: 16 to 34 ms (it was 4 ms). On the real server not measured alone.
- **Run, passed.** `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npx vitest run packages/database/src/db packages/database/src/isolation` (19 files, 476 tests); the callers' tests (`packages/database/src/seed`, `league-making`, `schema/app-role.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/server/startup.test.ts`, `apps/worker`: 36 files, 279 tests); `npm run format:check`; the pending-decisions test. Not run: the whole suite, `npm run verify`, browser tests.

## For builder 2: the real server

- `npm run test:real-postgres` was run once here: with nothing planted `checkLoginRole` passes for `app_login`. **Two of its tests now fail and are yours to change** (`tests/real-postgres` is not this lane's): `login-roles.test.ts` "may-act-as-platform-owner" gets the (d) sentence for `platform.p_own_…_kept` too; `planted-fault.test.ts` now stops at `makeMadeUpLeague` because the guard refuses `public.programs` (fence off) before `league-fence` runs.
- Plant each, by the tables' owner, and see `checkLoginRole` as `app_login` refuse with its sentence, then run the statement and see it pass: (a) `alter table public.games no force row level security`, and a `league_id` table in a new schema; (b) `create policy p on public.games using (true)`, and one `for select to r using (true)` with `grant r to app_login`; a changed `games_league_fence`; (c) a definer function granted to app_user, and one granted only to a role app_login may SET to; (d) a table and a view in `public` or `platform`.
- Then, connected AS `app_login` itself (no `set role`), query `public.games` and `public.leagues` under each wide plant and show it saw both leagues, and with the fence whole saw none: the guard is the only thing standing between.

## What I distrust

- Policies are compared as `pg_get_expr` prints them on PGlite (PostgreSQL 17); the real server is 16. It passed there with nothing planted, but a different server version may print a migration's rule differently and stop the start.
- On Supabase its own schemas hold security-definer functions; any that `app_login` can run (PUBLIC's default execute) will be named, and the test copy has not been checked. A league column not named `league_id` is not seen.
- The fence tests share one database; a failing test leaves its plant behind and later tests fail too.

## Builder 2 (the real PostgreSQL 16.15), 2026-11-26

- **The two failing tests: both plants trip a new, right refusal, so the TESTS changed, not the guard.** `login-roles` "may-act-as-platform-owner": `platform.p_own_…_kept` is a table no migration made, so it now expects the (d) sentence too. `planted-fault`: the league-making tool rightly refuses a database whose fence is off, so the test makes its two leagues before the plant and hands them to `league-fence.test.ts` (`REAL_POSTGRES_MADE_UP_LEAGUES`); it still sees that run fail naming `programs`, and now also sees `checkLoginRole` name `public.programs`.
- **New: `tests/real-postgres/fence-guard.test.ts` (13 tests).** Each plant by the tables' owner, refused with its exact sentence, put right by the sentence's own statement, removed in a `finally`, guard passing after both: (a) `programs` not forced; off; a `league_id` table in a new schema; a new `public` league table (named by (a) and (d)); (b) `using (true)` on `programs`; a role with SELECT and a `for select to r using (true)` policy on `leagues`, granted to app_login; a changed `programs` policy; (c) two definer functions in a new schema, one granted to app_user, one only to a role app_login may SET to (inherit false); (d) a table in `public` and a view in `platform`.
- **As app_login itself (no `set role`).** With league A or B set it sees only its own rows in every league table it may read (the owner sees both leagues in `leagues`, `programs` and others); with none set, no league. Under the off fence, both wide policies and the changed policy it sees both leagues' rows; through the planted definer function it counts both leagues' programs while its own query counts 0. So each plant is real and the guard is what stands between.
- **Builder 1's doubts.** (1) Policies: all of `migration-catalog.ts`'s rules (made on PostgreSQL 17) equal what 16.15 prints, compared as the guard compares (T-470); a test pins it, and still passes with the `public.` stripping switched off, so the prints are the same, not only alike. (2) Every foreign key to `public.leagues` is a column named `league_id` (a test reads them all on the real server; the migrations have no other league column). (3) Supabase's own definer functions: not checkable here.
- **Needs the founder (one line for STATUS):** in a session the founder started, the lead starts the website once against the test copy (its start runs this guard) and reads any sentence naming a function in Supabase's own schemas (`auth`, `storage`, `graphql`, `extensions`, `vault`, `pgbouncer`, `realtime`), then revokes it or adds it, with its reason, to the reviewed list.
- **Breaks by hand.** All four parts of `checkFence` emptied: the 9 plant tests failed, the 4 nothing-planted ones passed; the catalog's `games_league_fence` rule altered: every file stops at league making (the guard refuses); test-side breaks (no league set in the login's transaction, the column name, a spacing change in a policy) each failed its own test. All put back.
- **Run, passed.** `npm run test:real-postgres` whole on a fresh server (9 files, 59 tests; it stopped clean); `npx vitest run packages/database/src/db packages/database/src/isolation apps/worker apps/web/src/server/startup.test.ts` (32 files, 564 tests: the embedded start, the worker's start and the web start pass with nothing planted); `npm run check`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`.
- **Not done.** The website's and the worker's own start functions were not run against the real server (they need a whole configuration); their guard is the same `checkLoginRole` these tests run. Not run: `npm run verify`, the whole unit suite, browser tests.
- **What I distrust.** A plant left by a test killed mid-run stays on a reused server: `node scripts/real-postgres.mjs stop` and start again. A league table only the owner fills (none today) would not be shown filled by the own-league test.
